segments.name: Cardiorenal care
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and commercializes medical devices for ultrafiltration therapy to treat fluid overload in adult and pediatric patients.
segments.evidence: The Company and the Company's chief operating decision-maker, the Company's chief executive officer, view the Company's operations and manages its business as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Nuwellis generates revenue mainly from selling consoles and disposable blood filters and catheters used with the Aquadex System, primarily to U.S. hospitals and clinics through a direct salesforce, and to international specialty distributors.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is generated mainly from the sale of consoles and disposable blood filters and catheters used in conjunction with the Aquadex System.

changes.text: In 2016, the Company acquired the Aquadex Business from a subsidiary of Baxter and halted all clinical evaluations of its prior C-Pulse System technology.
changes.evidence: During 2016, we acquired the Aquadex Business and announced that we were halting all clinical evaluations of our prior technology, the C-Pulse System.

changes.text: In 2021, the Company changed its name from CHF Solutions, Inc. to Nuwellis, Inc.
changes.evidence: On April 27, 2021, the Company announced that it was changing its name from CHF Solutions, Inc. to Nuwellis, Inc.
